title: Delete Node in a BST

story.title: Removing a Fruit Carefully
story.text: The gardener walks down to the fruit to remove. A leaf just drops off; a fruit with one branch is replaced by that branch; with two branches, it takes the value of the smallest fruit on its right and that one is removed instead.
story.goal: Delete key from the BST and return the root.

hints: LeetCode accepts any valid BST after deletion; these tests expect the in-order-successor approach.
